name: WF04 - Error Handling & Logging
description: Captures unhandled production failures from WF01–WF03 via Error Trigger, logs redacted error rows to Supabase workflow_errors, and alerts admins on Slack even if DB logging fails.

nodes.notes: Catches unhandled production failures from WF01, WF02, and WF03.

nodes.name: Prepare Admin Alert

nodes.name: Send Slack Admin Alert
